philosophy: One launcher (./pfy). Inference starts first as a pluggable OpenAI-compatible local endpoint (ADR-0014); any llama-swap / llama-server / Shimmy / Ollama server counts. Harnesses attach. Inspired by Ollama→Hermes/OpenCode installers and Exo setup.sh simplicity — without hard-coding a vendor.

harnesses.name: llama-swap
harnesses.summary: Hot-swap + TTL in front of llama.cpp llama-server; preferred tok/s local spine
harnesses.setup: install llama-swap + llama-server; serve OpenAI /v1 (often :8080). Override PFY_LOCAL_RUNTIME=llama-swap
harnesses.issue_stub: Complete llama-swap adapter: detect + health + LOCAL_OPENAI_BASE_URL in ./pfy start

harnesses.name: llama.cpp (llama-server)
harnesses.summary: llama.cpp OpenAI-compat server; tok/s path without hot-swap
harnesses.setup: install llama-server; listen :8080 /v1. Pair with llama-swap for model swap
harnesses.issue_stub: llama-server health in detect-local-runtime.sh; do not vendor sources

harnesses.name: Shimmy
harnesses.summary: Tiny Rust OpenAI-compat local server (FREE forever); 2026 Ollama-killer candidate
harnesses.setup: STUB — install shimmy (Michael-A-Kuykendall/shimmy); often :11435. Honest stub until adapter ships
harnesses.issue_stub: Shimmy adapter: detect :11435, OpenAI /v1, pfy start shimmy — no fake healthy

harnesses.name: Ollama
harnesses.summary: Local model server; first-class adapter (T-0101), not the only runtime
harnesses.setup: install ollama; ollama serve; pull models via pfy models pull
harnesses.issue_stub: Complete Ollama adapter: serve + pull + health in ./pfy start

harnesses.name: Grok Build / CLI
harnesses.summary: Primary coding agent (subscription); skills via bootstrap/grok-cli

harnesses.name: OpenCode
harnesses.summary: Local+cloud worker surface; skills SoT shared with Grok
harnesses.setup: install opencode; point skills at bootstrap/grok-cli/skills
harnesses.issue_stub: OpenCode host adapter: detect, skill path, local-openai base_url, pfy start opencode
